definitions.explanation: The assorted smaller costs that come with a purchase or transaction on top of the main price — fees, taxes, insurance, and handling charges. Standard wording in real estate, car sales, and travel.

examples.japanese: {諸費用|しょひよう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。

⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{諸費用|しょひよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧しまう。
examples.english: If you add the various fees to the price of the car, it goes over my budget.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧や⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{諸費用|しょひよう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧おく⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When buying a house, you need to factor in not only the price of the property but also various costs such as taxes and handling fees.

notes:
The prefix ⟦{諸|しょ}→諸〜：03956_sho⟧ (various, several) attached to ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ (expenses). It appears mainly in written quotes and contracts, where it covers items too numerous to list individually.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {諸費用|しょひよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: for various costs to be incurred
- {諸費用|しょひよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧: to include miscellaneous costs
- {諸費用|しょひよう}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: miscellaneous costs included

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧: handling fee — one specific charge, often part of the {諸費用|しょひよう}
- ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧: expenses — costs a business incurs in operating, viewed from the accounting side
